title: Noor and the Harbor
author: Rosalind Almeida
blurb: Kestrel Kavanagh, a lighthouse keeper's granddaughter and part-time novelist, swears the heart is a muscle like any other: trainable, containable. Then the person behind a decade of letters moves in next door — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must say the sentence that has been rehearsed for a decade, and time is already running out.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
